upheld.detail: The range is plain inline text inside .catalog-count with a CSS '·' separator. On narrow screens, where the toolbar also holds the Sort dropdown, the text '101 products · Prices $21.99 – $699.00' can wrap mid-range (e.g. after '$21.99 –'), leave the '·' at the start of a line, or crowd the dropdown.
